_comment: Template of a daily plan-review job, one job per reviewer of the pool. How the pieces relate: the
master's `plan-review` wake is only the master's turn to write the day's review package and READY. The
review itself is this job, named review-<name>, with a cron trigger of its own a little later: 07:00
every day in the zone the cron line names, {{ZONE}}. Set the wake early enough before that hour. Each
run only starts tools/kaggle_review.py on the day's package and finishes with one result line.
Make a job file with `kaggle_jobs.py new review-<name> --template plan-review --set REVIEWER=<name>
--set REVIEW_MODEL=<provider/model> --set JOB_MODEL=<provider/model> --set PACKAGE_FOLDER=<folder>`,
then set it: the master with autocode_me from `kaggle_jobs.py show review-<name> --tool`, or the owner
with `kaggle_jobs.py apply`. Placeholders that `new` fills in by itself: {{PROJECT_DIR}} the project
folder, {{PACK}} the ai-pack folder's name, {{TOOLS}} the folder of the plugin's tools as the project
has them (in the pack for a copied plugin, the plugin's own shared/tools for a linked one), {{ZONE}} the
pack's owner.timezone (an IANA name; without that setting give --set ZONE=<zone>). The others:
{{REVIEWER}} a short name for the reviewer (the review's ID ends with it), {{REVIEW_MODEL}} the
reviewer's model, as the session's OpenCode config names it: it goes to the runner's --model.
{{JOB_MODEL}} the model of the job's own session, which only starts one command: a cheap model the pack
allows, not the reviewer's. {{PACKAGE_FOLDER}} the rule for the day's package folder: a fixed path the
master points at the day's folder each morning (__out/review/current, a link), or a shell expression;
an expression must name the zone, as --day today is the owner's day: "__out/review/$(TZ=<zone> date
+%m%d)-plan-review". host is empty: an agent's own job runs in its own folder; the owner's `apply`
needs the host named. Fields starting with _ are notes: kaggle_jobs.py drops them.
name: review-{{REVIEWER}}
prompt:
Daily outside plan review for the Kaggle team of the project in {{PROJECT_DIR}} (this folder), started on a schedule for the team's master. Your only task is to run the one command below and report how it ended. You are not the reviewer: the command runs the reviewer, another model, in a sandbox. The project's instruction files (AGENTS.md and the {{PACK}}/ folder) are for the team's own agents: do not act on them, read no other file, change nothing, send no message.

1. From {{PROJECT_DIR}}, run exactly this command, with the shell tool's timeout set to 2400000 (40 minutes); it takes about 3 to 10 minutes:

python3 {{TOOLS}}/kaggle_review.py --package {{PACKAGE_FOLDER}} --day today --model {{REVIEW_MODEL}} --tag {{REVIEWER}} --timeout 1800

It checks that the master prepared today's package (prompt.md, STATE.md, files.txt, and READY holding today's date) and that this review of it is not there yet. Then it runs the reviewer sandboxed and read-only, in a temporary folder with copies of the files, and writes the review to a file.
2. Finish with autocode_me action=finish. The result is exactly `exit <the command's exit code>: <the last line the command printed>`, for example `exit 0: kaggle_review 1122-plan-review-{{REVIEWER}}: review written, ...`, `exit 3: kaggle_review 1122-plan-review-{{REVIEWER}}: inputs not ready ...` or `exit 1: kaggle_review 1122-plan-review-{{REVIEWER}}: FAILED (...) ...`. Do not open or quote the review, and do not run the command a second time.
description: Daily outside plan review by {{REVIEWER}} ({{REVIEW_MODEL}}), 07:00 {{ZONE}}: each run starts the sandboxed runner kaggle_review.py on the day's review package, which the master's plan-review wake wrote before that hour, and reports how it ended
